correctness.rationale: The primary source gives the exact capacity union \([0,H(Y_1\mid Y_2)]\times[0,H(Y_2\mid Y_1)]\) over input distributions. For a positive support weight, the submitted weighted entropy objective has strictly negative second variation on the simplex tangent space and its maximizer is interior. Eliminating the Lagrange multiplier from the two stationary equations yields \(\ln x\ln y=\ln(1+x)\ln(1+y)\), equivalently \(\psi(x)\psi(y)=1\). Strict monotonicity of \(\psi\) gives uniqueness and the converse reconstructs the support weight. Fresh numerical root solves for representative \(x\) values independently satisfied both KKT equations to numerical precision; the continuum conclusion is analytic. At symmetry the relation gives \(x=y=\varphi^{-1}\), consistent with the source's exact maximum-sum point.
correctness.risk: The theorem is specific to the classical deterministic Blackwell map and this mutually-confidential-message capacity formula.

value.rationale: The Blackwell channel is the focal explicit example in the new confidential-broadcast capacity paper. Replacing repeated two-dimensional numerical support optimization by a unique one-dimensional analytic involution gives a natural exact description of the entire Pareto curve and recovers the known golden-ratio point as a special case.

final_claim: For the classical Blackwell broadcast channel with two mutually confidential messages, every non-axis Pareto-optimal input has odds \(x=b/a\), \(y=c/a\in(0,1)\) satisfying \(\psi(x)\psi(y)=1\), where \(\psi(t)=-\ln t/\ln(1+t)\); this relation is a one-dimensional involutive parametrization of the full curved frontier, with symmetry at \(x=y=\varphi^{-1}\) and rates \((\log_2\varphi,\log_2\varphi)\).
limitations: Classical Blackwell deterministic map and the exact confidential-message capacity notion of the source paper only.
Axis endpoints are treated separately from the interior odds parametrization.
